title: The Church and the World
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The church and the world teaches that God’s people live as a holy witness within the world without being ruled by the world’s values, desires, systems, or unbelief. The church is sent into the world while belonging to Christ.
summary: The church and the world teaches that God’s people live as a holy witness within the world without being ruled by the world’s values, desires, systems, or unbelief. The church is sent into the world while belonging to Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His people into the world as witnesses while keeping them from belonging to the world. His cross, kingdom, truth, and love shape the church’s presence among unbelievers.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The church is not called to escape the world in fear or blend into the world in compromise. Jesus sends His people into the world as witnesses while praying that they be kept from evil.

The world in Scripture often refers to fallen human rebellion against God. Its desires, pride, values, and systems can pressure the church to conform.

The church must therefore be distinct. Believers are called to shine as lights, live honorably, resist worldly desires, and offer their bodies to God rather than being conformed to this age.

This distinction does not mean hatred of people. The church loves neighbors, serves faithfully, proclaims the Gospel, and bears witness to Christ while refusing to be ruled by unbelief.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Churches can fall into two errors: withdrawal without mission, or engagement without holiness. Both weaken witness. Scripture calls for holy presence: in the world, sent by Christ, but not owned by the world.

This doctrine helps believers navigate pressure from culture, politics, entertainment, relationships, and fear. The church’s identity must be shaped by Christ, not by the age around it.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as a witness without surrendering to the world’s mold. Love people, serve your neighbors, speak the Gospel, and pursue holiness. Ask where the world has shaped your thinking more than Scripture, and return to Christ as Lord over your life and church.
